open_end_unit_20.wall_hung_note: NOT OFFERED: no 'Surch. for wall-hung version' line in the margin of printed p.450-452 (110-dpi renders, 2026-10-03).
open_end_unit_20.notes: Printed d.37,5 / 64,5 / 69,5 = side panel 35 / 62 / 67 + the 2,2 door plane (printed p.450 header: 'The depth measurements are based on 2.2 cm thick doors'). depth_includes_front: drawn from the door plane back, flush with the doored units beside it. WIDTH 20 IS CODED, NOT ORDERED: one width per row, unlike the 15-45 / 45-90 open units of printed p.455-456. price_points_by_band: the printed points, bands 1-11 of printed p.453-454. Bands 3, 9 and 11 are '-' on every row of p.450-452 and are ABSENT from the map, never 0 - '-' means not made in that finish. Nothing reads these yet (no appearance layer, M1.8); they are held because the row prints them and a re-read costs a render. The icon draws the open box with intermediate shelves; their number is read off an icon only and not recorded (interior_confirmed stays empty).

open_end_unit_20_double.notes: COMBINED DEPTH, BUILT AS THE PRINTED ENVELOPE (2026-10-03, S4). The row prints W 20, d. 75 / 102 / 107 / 129 and names the two side panels it spans ('for 62+35-cm deep side panel + door thickness'): the end unit of two runs standing back to back, an island or peninsula end. 75 = 37,5 + 37,5; 102 = 64,5 + 37,5; 107 = 69,5 + 37,5; 129 = 64,5 + 64,5 - the sum of the two single depths, door plane to door plane. Domain rule 4: one volume W x D x H, every number printed. NOT drawn: where the two runs' backs meet inside it, which way round the 62/35 pair faces, any shelf - none of that is printed. Placing it is the user's job; the engine draws the box at the run like any other unit.
